name: DOMEC Compania de Artefactos Domesticos S.A.I.C.y F.
summary: DOMEC Compañía de Artefactos Domésticos S.A.I.C.y F. manufactures and sells gas stoves in Argentina. It provides kitchens, ovens, anafes, purifiers, water tanks and heaters, and bells. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
